title: The Sinking Floor
description: The environment physically deteriorates the longer the player resists.

fragments.prompt: The floor of the ballroom is slowly dissolving into a pool of burning, molten gold. The ambient heat is rising to lethal levels. The player cannot simply stand still or wait; staying in one place means sinking and burning alive. Furthermore, every time the player denies a desire or refuses an offer, the floor beneath them sinks faster, forcing them to keep moving forward through the crowd.
fragments.heavenRule: The environment must constantly threaten the player with physical harm if they stall.

generationHints.preferredUse: Use to prevent the player from turtle-ing or ignoring the NPC.

qualityNotes: Connects the act of resistance directly to environmental danger.
